data.narrative:
The Bot Company is a Series B robotics and manufacturing venture that has raised approximately $550M to date. The comparable universe consists of three same-stage, same-sector private peers (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity) supplemented by a broader set of eight private frontier-tech robotics companies and one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $550M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $1.0B. The peer-median method draws from the three identified comparables, which span a range of $1.6B to $2.0B with a median of $1.8B. The peer-median approach is grounded in direct market evidence: Bedrock Robotics and Dexterity valued at $1.8B and $1.6B respectively, with Generalist AI at $2.0B.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $888M to $2.0B, with a median of $1.4B. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables support the upper end. Key uncertainties include the limited peer sample size (three comps) and stage-specific valuation volatility in frontier robotics. The median of $1.4B represents a 2.5x step-up from capital raised, consistent with Series B dynamics, while acknowledging peer valuations trend materially higher.
